lines: Din kuch aise guzarta hai koi
couplets.en: This is how someone gets through the day.
As though paying back a kindness.

lines: Din kuch aise guzarta hai koi
couplets.en: This is how someone gets through the day.
The mirror put me at ease.

lines: Humko is ghar mein jaanta hai koi
couplets.en: Someone in this house knows me.

lines: Pak gaya hai shahr pe phal shayad
couplets.en: Perhaps the fruit has ripened over the city.

lines: Phir se patthar uchhaalta hai koi

couplets.en: As though paying back a kindness.

lines: Tumhare gham ki dali utha kar
couplets.en: I picked up a small piece of your sorrow.

lines: Zabaan pe rakh li hai dekho maine
couplets.en: Look, I have laid it on my tongue.
It is melting drop by drop.

lines: Main qatra-qatra hi jee raha hoon
couplets.en: I live a drop at a time.
The silences have been echoing for a while.
As though someone were calling to me.

lines: Din kuch aise guzarta hai koi
couplets.en: This is how someone gets through the day.
As though paying back a kindness.
